subject: [PATCH v2 07/12] mm/collapse: name the per-table scan reset for what it resets

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch renames the function collapse_control_init_scan to collapse_scan_reset to better reflect its purpose of resetting scan accumulations before each PTE table scan. The rename is done to prepare for future changes where a control will have an init and release function, each run once per series of scans. No functional change is made.
